units.source_text: 不過，這個女人雖然嘴裡沒說「真寂寞啊」，

en.t: However, although this woman never said aloud, "I am so lonely,"

units.source_text: 但她身體的外部輪廓中卻環繞著劇烈的無言寂寞，彷彿流動著一寸見方的氣流，

en.t: yet a fierce, wordless loneliness circled the outer outline of her body, like a current of air flowing in a space an inch square,

units.source_text: 只要靠近她，我的身體就會被那股氣流包裹，

en.t: and whenever I drew near her, my own body would be wrapped in that current,

units.source_text: 與我那長滿刺的陰鬱氣流恰到好處地交融在一起，

en.t: and it would blend perfectly with the gloomy, thorn-covered current of air that was mine,

units.source_text: 就像「落在水底岩石上的枯葉」，使我得以從靠近和不安中脫身。

en.t: like a "dead leaf settled on a rock at the bottom of the water," and this let me free myself from the fear of closeness and from unease.
